name: Snapjaws, Mon!
summary: In Revantusk Village, Katoom the Angler asks you to deal with saltwater snapjaws ruining his fishing. He wants fifteen turtles killed.

sections.title: Trouble on the Line
sections.body: Katoom the Angler asks you to help him and his neighbours in Revantusk Village. Saltwater snapjaws may look harmless, but they make fishing hard. One tears his line and steals his bait before he can fish for five minutes. Katoom wants you to kill fifteen of the turtles.

faq.q: Who asks you to hunt the turtles?
faq.answer: Katoom the Angler, a fisher in Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands, asks you to hunt the turtles.

faq.q: Why does Katoom want the saltwater snapjaws killed?
faq.answer: Katoom says the saltwater snapjaws tear his fishing line and steal his bait. He can scarcely fish for five minutes before one interrupts him.

faq.q: How many snapjaws need to be slain?
faq.answer: You need to kill fifteen saltwater snapjaw turtles.
